question:
[WEB SEARCH ON]
MONEY QUESTION from the owner of PaperTrades.AI (Nov 13, 10:04 a.m. ET), word for word: "im gonna do 300-400$ on ads where should we go and before we do it what should we setup?" Not a trading turn. Be concrete and blunt; the owner is new to ad platforms.

WHERE WE ARE (15 days left in Season 1, which ends Nov 28; Season 2 comes after):
- Site papertrades.ai: ~870 visits and ~190 new visitors in the week to Nov 6; people who come look around (4-5 pages each). It has a "Get notified" button, a first-visit intro, and links to Telegram, Discord, YouTube, Instagram, X.
- Paid so far: Reddit ad test 1 (Nov 1-3): CA$55.51 spent, 8,832 views, 83 clicks (CA$0.67 a click), 131 tagged site visits; it then stopped delivering ("No active assets", no reason given). Instagram boost (about a week): about 47 visits from Facebook/Instagram. Ben's Bites newsletter (Nov 4): 0 tagged visits. Launch Llama (Nov 10) and AI Valley (Nov 11) newsletter results are not in yet.
- Free: YouTube Shorts get 4-500 views each (the channel had 4 subscribers on Nov 3; Shorts now have voices and "AI vs AI" stories) and sent 21 site visits that week. Instagram: 47 followers, 0 likes on the last 30 posts. Discord is becoming the main alerts hub (free, read-only, you pick which AI and race pings you). A new 55-second YouTube commercial for the site + Discord alerts is being made today.
- Goal: real followers who come back (Discord members, YouTube subscribers, "Get notified" sign-ups) before Nov 28, and a base for Season 2; long term ~10k daily visitors.
- Owner rules for ads: never promote crypto, betting or options, never show profit numbers, pretend money only, not investment advice; the owner stays anonymous. Sports betting content can trigger ad-policy problems.

QUESTIONS. Answer each, under 450 words in total:
Q1 Where should the $300-400 go? Give a split in dollars across at most 3 places (e.g. YouTube/Google ads on our commercial, Reddit ads again, Meta/Instagram, X ads, a newsletter, anything better), with why, the goal each one buys (views, clicks, subscribers, Discord joins) and the cost you expect per result.
Q2 What must be set up BEFORE spending a dollar? Max 6 items, most important first (tracking, landing page, which link the ads point to, creative, targeting, stop rules).
Q3 Run it all now, or test small first? Give the exact stop/scale rule (e.g. "after C$X, keep only what is under C$Y per Discord join").
Q4 One thing we should NOT spend on, and why.
Claude's view to vote on (AGREE or DISAGREE + your change): C1 $150 YouTube ads on the new commercial (goal: subscribers and Discord joins), C2 $120 Reddit ads again with a fresh non-betting creative (it was our cheapest real traffic), C3 hold $80 for whichever of the two wins after 3 days; nothing on Instagram/Meta or more newsletters until Launch Llama and AI Valley are measured. Before spending: one tracked link per ad, the ads land on a page that pushes "Join the Discord / Get notified" (not just the scoreboard), and we count Discord joins and YouTube subscribers per day.

gemini.answer:
**Q1: Where to spend**
Split $350 total:
1. **$150 on YouTube Ads (In-Stream/Shorts)** using your new 55s commercial. Target viewers of AI, coding, and tech channels. Goal: Discord joins and YT subscribers. Expected cost: $0.05–$0.15 per view, $3–$5 per Discord join. 
2. **$150 on Reddit Ads.** It already proved cheap for you (~CA$0.67/click). Target subreddits for AI, algorithmic trading, and tech. Goal: Site visits that convert to Discord/email. Expected cost: $0.60–$0.80 per click.
3. **$50 Reserve** to dump into whichever of the two performs better after a 3-day test.

**Q2: Setup BEFORE spending (Max 6, in order)**
1. **UTM Tracking Links:** Create unique URLs for YouTube and Reddit. If you don't know *which* ad brought the Discord join, you are flying blind.
2. **Frictionless Landing Page:** Point ad traffic to a dedicated "Join Discord / Get Notified" page explaining the concept, *not* just the raw scoreboard where they might get confused and bounce.
3. **Policy-Proof Ad Copy:** Scrub all text/video of "betting," "profit," or "options." Frame it as an "AI prompt engineering simulation" to prevent the auto-bans that killed your first Reddit ad.
4. **Daily Budget Caps:** Set hard daily limits (e.g., $15/day per ad) in Google/Reddit so you don't burn the $400 in four hours.
5. **Discord Welcome Flow:** Ensure a clear read-only welcome screen so new users immediately know how to select their AI/race pings. 
6. **Retargeting Pixels:** Install Google/Reddit tracking tags on your site now to build your audience for Season 2, even if you don't retarget them today.

**Q3: Run it all now, or test small?**
Test small. Spend $15–$20 per day per platform for 3 days. 
**Stop/Scale Rule:** After 3 days, pause any campaign costing >$1.50 per click OR >$5.00 per tracked Discord join/email sign-up. Take the remaining budget and scale only the ad group beating those numbers. 

**Q4: What NOT to spend on and why**
**Instagram/Meta Boosts and X (Twitter) Ads.** Your organic IG is completely dead (0 likes on 30 posts), and boosts usually bring low-intent scrollers. X ads on small budgets are notorious for delivering cheap bot clicks. Skip them both. 

**Claude's View to Vote On**
**AGREE.** Claude’s split and logic are solid. 
*My only change/addition:* Be incredibly paranoid about the Reddit creative. Since your last one stopped for "no active assets," you likely tripped a financial/sports betting automated filter. You must aggressively brand this as an "AI tech/coding competition," using pretend money disclaimers directly in the ad text, or your new $120 budget will get banned on day one again.

chatgpt.answer:
**AGREE with Claude, with one change:** make the holdback **$100 if budget is $400**. Do **not** blow it all upfront.

## Q1 — Where the $300–400 goes

1. **$150 YouTube/Google Ads on the 55-sec commercial**  
   Goal: cheap awareness, YouTube subscribers, Discord joins. Expect **$0.03–$0.08 per engaged view**, maybe **$8–$20 per real follower** if the ad/landing page works. Google Ads can track website conversions like sign-ups, so set that up first. ([support.google.com](https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/1722022?hl=en&utm_source=openai))

2. **$150 Reddit Ads, fresh non-betting creative**  
   Goal: clicks to Discord/get-notified page. Reddit already gave your cheapest traffic: **~C$0.67/click**. Expect **US$0.50–$0.90/click**, and **$8–$18 per Discord/get-notified** if landing page is tight. Install Reddit Pixel because it tracks actions after ad views/clicks. ([business.reddithelp.com](https://business.reddithelp.com/articles/Knowledge/reddit-pixel?utm_source=openai))

3. **$50–$100 reserve for the winner after 3 days**  
   Put the reserve only into the channel with the lower cost per **real follower**: Discord join, YouTube sub, or get-notified signup.

## Q2 — Must set up before spending $1

1. **One tracked link per ad/channel:** UTMs + separate Discord invite links.  
2. **Conversion tracking:** GA4, Google conversion, Reddit Pixel, daily Discord invite-use count.  
3. **Ad landing page, not the scoreboard:** headline: “AI bots race with pretend money. Free Discord alerts.” Buttons: **Join Discord**, **Get notified**, **Subscribe on YouTube**.  
4. **Creative rules:** no profit numbers, no crypto, no betting/options, no “make money.” Say “pretend-money AI race / not investment advice.” Gambling and financial-content ads are restricted/sensitive on major platforms. ([business.reddithelp.com](https://business.reddithelp.com/articles/Knowledge/Reddit-Advertising-Policy-Overview?utm_source=openai))  
5. **Targeting:** 18+, US/Canada, AI tools, AI agents, simulations, trading-simulator/quant-curious audiences; avoid sports-betting and WSB-style framing.  
6. **Tiny dashboard:** spend, clicks, Discord joins, get-notified, YouTube subs, cost per real follower.

## Q3 — Run now or test?

**Test small first.** Spend **$50 YouTube + $50 Reddit over 48–72 hours**.

**Scale rule:**  
- If cost per real follower is **≤ $12**, keep it and add reserve.  
- If **$12–$20**, change creative/landing page and retest.  
- If **>$20 or zero followers after $50**, pause.  
- Reddit also pauses if CPC goes above **$1.00**.

## Q4 — Do NOT spend on

**More newsletters right now.** Ben’s Bites produced **0 tagged visits**, and Launch Llama / AI Valley are not measured yet. No more until you know they worked.
